name: Integrate HubSpot – Connect 20+ Plugins with HubSpot, No-Code Automation
author: Plugcrux

sections.description:
This plugin helps you connect your WordPress forms with HubSpot without any coding. It supports Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor Forms, Gravity Forms, and Formidable Forms, making data transfer smooth and hassle-free.

Automatically send form submissions to HubSpot CRM modules like Contacts, Deals, Companies, and Tickets. Just set it up once and start managing your leads without extra effort.

Designed for speed and accuracy, this plugin ensures fast and reliable data syncing. You can use pre-configured field mappings or customize them as per your needs.

With full support for Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor Forms, Gravity Forms, and Formidable Forms, you can easily manage form data and streamline your workflow. This HubSpot CRM integration for WordPress makes lead management simple and efficient.

Watch the video overview of HubSpot Integration for WordPress Forms

This plugin is an all-in-one solution for integrating Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Elementor Forms, and Formidable Forms, ensuring seamless lead capture and customer management.

Get started today and automate your WordPress form data syncing!

No need to install different plugins for each form builder—this plugin seamlessly integrates with all major WordPress form builders in a single solution. Connect and automate lead capture, customer data syncing, and form submissions with:

Supported Forms:
– Contact Form 7
– Gravity Forms
– WPForms
– Elementor Forms
– Formidable Forms

Need support for additional forms? Let us know! Submit a request via the Feature Request or contact us using the Support Form.

One-Click Account Authentication

Easily authenticate your account with a single click, eliminating the need for complex API configurations. Follow these simple steps to connect your account:

  1. Go to the Accounts Page – Navigate to the plugin settings and open the Accounts section.
  2. Add a New Account – Click the “Add Account” button.
  3. Fill in the account name.
  4. Authenticate – Click the “Authenticate” button to initiate the OAuth authentication process.
  5. Grant Access – You will be redirected to the authorization page. After granting the required permissions, your account will be successfully added.

This seamless authentication process saves time, improves security, and makes CRM management effortless for businesses using Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor Forms, Gravity Forms, and Formidable Forms.

Setup

Once your CRM account is authenticated, proceed to the Setup Page to configure your form integrations effortlessly. Follow these steps to map your WordPress forms with CRM:

  1. Go to the Setup Page – Navigate to the Setup section in the plugin settings.
  2. Add a New Integration – Click the “Add Integration” button.
  3. Select Your Form Plugin – Choose from Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor Forms, Gravity Forms, or Formidable Forms.
  4. Choose Your Account – Select the account you want to integrate with.
  5. Assign a CRM Module – Pick a module (Contacts, Companies, Deal, Tickets) where form data should be stored.
  6. Map Fields – Match form fields to CRM using an intuitive drag-and-drop interface.
  7. Save & Activate Integration – Once field mapping is done, save your settings to enable automatic data syncing.

This plugin makes lead capture, customer management, and sales automation seamless—eliminating manual work and boosting efficiency.

Error Log & Resync Failed Submissions

Easily monitor and manage integration errors with the built-in Error Log Page. This feature ensures that no data is lost due to failed submissions, allowing you to identify issues and retry sending records with a single click.

How to Use the Error Log Page

  1. Navigate to the Error Log Page – Access it from the plugin settings menu.
  2. View Failed Submissions – See a detailed list of form entries that failed to sync with CRM.
  3. Identify Errors – Check error messages and reasons for failure (e.g., invalid credentials, missing required fields, API timeout).
  4. Resync Failed Entries – Click the “Resync” button to retry sending the failed records.
  5. Delete Error Logs – Clean up logs by removing old or resolved error entries.

Key Features of Error Logging & Resync

  • Real-Time Error Tracking – Instantly detect and troubleshoot failed CRM submissions.
  • One-Click Resync Option – Fix integration issues without manually re-entering data.
  • Detailed Error Messages – Get specific error reasons to resolve integration problems quickly.
  • Email Notifications for Failed Entries – Stay informed about errors and take action immediately.
  • Supports Multi-Account Resync – Retry failed records across multiple accounts.

With this Error Log & Resync feature, you get full control over your CRM integration, ensuring that every form submission is successfully processed.

Settings

The Settings Page allows you to customize and manage how your integration functions. From data retention options to email notifications, this section gives you complete control over your integration preferences.

How to Use the Settings Page

  1. Navigate to the Settings Page – Go to the plugin menu and open the Settings tab.
  2. Manage Data Handling – Choose whether to store form submission data in WordPress before sending it to CRM.
  3. Enable or Disable Auto Data Deletion – Automatically remove stored data when uninstalling the plugin to keep your site clean.
  4. Configure Email Notifications – Get alerts when form submissions fail to sync with CRM.

With these customizable settings, you can fine-tune how your integration works, ensuring optimal performance and reliability.

Benefits of Using This Plugin

  • Single-click authentication with your account.
  • Manage multiple accounts with a simple and intuitive UI.
  • View all details in a popup, eliminating confusion with next and previous pages.
  • Support for custom fields, geolocation fields, and UTM fields.
  • Multiple options for adding CRM records: add, update, skip, etc.
  • Filter records using criteria like “contains,” “starts with,” or “ends with.”
  • Resync option for records that failed to post to CRM.
  • Email notifications for any record that fails to post to CRM.

Support

Need help or have a feature request?

  • Contact Support
  • Feature Request

Website: https://integrazo.com/
Email: support@integrazo.com

Additional Notes

This plugin is compatible with WordPress multisite installations. Tested rigorously to ensure reliable and efficient CRM integrations.
sections.installation:
Installing and setting up the plugin is quick and straightforward. Follow these steps to get started:

Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. In the search bar, type Integrazo and locate this plugin.
  4. Click Install Now, then activate it.
  5. Open the plugin settings and follow the guided setup to configure your form integration.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Log in to your WordPress dashboard and go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Click Upload Plugin and select the downloaded ZIP file.
  4. Click Install Now, then activate it.
  5. Access the plugin settings to complete the setup.
sections.faq:
Which WordPress forms does this plugin support?

This plugin seamlessly integrates with multiple WordPress form builders to automate lead capture and sync submissions to HubSpot CRM. The supported forms include:

  • Contact Form 7 – Connect Contact Form 7 to HubSpot for effortless lead management.
  • Gravity Forms – Automate data transfer from Gravity Forms to HubSpot without manual work.
  • WPForms – Easily integrate WPForms with HubSpot to capture leads and sync form entries.
  • Elementor Forms – Send Elementor Forms submissions directly to HubSpot CRM for smooth automation.
  • Formidable Forms – Sync Formidable Forms with HubSpot to manage customer data efficiently.

Need support for additional forms? Submit a request via our Feature Request page or contact us through the Support Form.

How to connect Contact Form 7 with HubSpot?

To set up Contact Form 7 integration with HubSpot, follow these steps:

  • Open the plugin settings and go to the Setup tab.
  • Select Contact Form 7 as your form type.
  • Choose a HubSpot module (Contacts, Deals, Companies, etc.) for data mapping.
  • Map your form fields to HubSpot fields using an intuitive interface.
  • Click Save Integration to enable automatic syncing.

If you’re looking for other powerful integrations, check out our related plugins:

  • Zoho CRM & Bigin Integration – Connect any WordPress form to Zoho effortlessly.
  • Mailchimp Integration – Sync your WordPress forms with Mailchimp for email marketing.
  • Freshsales CRM Integration – Connect WordPress forms to Freshworks CRM.

How to integrate WPForms with HubSpot?

Setting up WPForms HubSpot integration is quick and easy. Follow these steps to connect your form with HubSpot CRM:

  • Navigate to the plugin settings and open the Setup tab.
  • Select WPForms as your form type.
  • Choose a HubSpot service and assign a module to store form data.
  • Match form fields with corresponding HubSpot fields for accurate data transfer.
  • Click Save Integration to activate seamless form syncing.

Looking for more WordPress automation solutions? Explore these recommended plugins:
* HubSpot Forms Integration – Send any WordPress form data to HubSpot instantly.
* Mailchimp Auto-Sync – Effortlessly sync WPForms entries with Mailchimp.
* Freshworks Forms Connector – Integrate WPForms with Freshworks CRM for lead automation.

With this WPForms HubSpot integration, you can streamline data collection and automate lead management without manual effort.

How to connect Elementor Forms with HubSpot?

Easily set up Elementor Forms HubSpot integration to automate data transfer. Follow these steps to connect your forms:

  • Open the plugin settings and go to the Setup section.
  • Select Elementor Forms as your form type.
  • Choose your preferred HubSpot service and assign a module for storing submissions.
  • Map form fields to HubSpot fields to ensure seamless data syncing.
  • Click Save Integration to activate the connection.

Want to enhance your WordPress automation? Check out these recommended plugins:
* HubSpot Contact Form Integration – Easily link any WordPress form with HubSpot.
* Mailchimp Sync for Elementor – Automatically send Elementor form data to Mailchimp.
* Freshworks CRM Form Integration – Automate lead management with Freshworks CRM.

With Elementor Forms HubSpot integration, you can streamline form submissions, automate lead capture, and improve CRM workflows effortlessly.

What happens if a form submission fails to reach HubSpot CRM?

If a submission fails, it will be logged in the Error Logs section. You can:

  • View the HubSpot CRM error message
  • Identify the HubSpot API issue causing the failure
  • Use the resync option to retry sending failed records

Does this plugin support advanced field mapping for HubSpot CRM?

Yes, this plugin includes advanced field mapping with custom field support for HubSpot CRM. You can:

  • Map WordPress form fields to HubSpot CRM custom fields and modules
  • Apply dynamic field mapping rules for HubSpot CRM integration
  • Ensure structured data transfer with accurate field matching

Can I send file attachments from WordPress forms to HubSpot CRM?

Yes, file uploads from WordPress forms to HubSpot CRM are supported in the premium version. You can:

  • Send file attachments from Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Elementor Forms, and Formidable Forms
  • Attach files directly to HubSpot CRM records

Is real-time sync available for HubSpot CRM?

Yes, the plugin enables real-time syncing between WordPress forms and HubSpot CRM to ensure instant lead capturing.

How do I troubleshoot HubSpot CRM integration issues?

If you face issues with HubSpot CRM integration, follow these steps:

  • Check your HubSpot API credentials and re-authenticate if needed
  • Verify that form fields are mapped correctly in the integration settings
  • Review the error logs to find failure reasons
  • Ensure your HubSpot API rate limits are not exceeded
  • Contact our Support Team for assistance

How secure is the data transfer between WordPress and HubSpot?

This plugin follows strong security protocols to protect HubSpot CRM data, including:

  • OAuth 2.0 authentication for secure API access
  • Encrypted API requests to prevent data breaches
  • GDPR compliance for WordPress form security and privacy
